summary: This is a Makefile target that runs the Composer dependency manager with an update command. When you invoke 'make composer-update', it will update all PHP project dependencies to their latest allowed versions without prompting for user input.

explanations.1: This defines a target name in a Makefile — it's like a named recipe you can run with 'make composer-update'.
explanations.2: ${CMD} is a variable reference that likely contains the shell or environment prefix needed to run the command; 'composer update' fetches the latest versions of PHP dependencies, and '--no-interaction' tells it to proceed automatically without asking questions.
